_about: Open probe questions for the personality study, one per element sheet in data/element_sheets.json. Deliberately open rather than factual: a closed question ('in which district is the Sagrada Familia') collapses to one correct sentence whatever the guide personality, which would measure nothing. Each carries an element_id so retrieval goes through the same direct-lookup path the device uses when vision names an element. There are no reference answers on purpose -- grounding is judged against the retrieved context, and plain-register references would penalise the artistic and child voices for doing their job. 'kind' is what the question invites: describe (what am I seeing) or explain (why/how is it like that).
